profile_text.body:
Synopsys is a public company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, trading under the ticker SNPS, with SEC CIK 0000883241. Its website describes it as an EDA tools, semiconductor IP and systems verification business, and says it delivers "comprehensive silicon-to-systems solutions that help innovators accelerate development, reduce risk, and drive breakthroughs." The site also carries a notice that visitors may be interacting with an AI-powered chatbot that provides general information about Synopsys, including its products and services, which the notice says may be incorrect or incomplete, and that chats may be accessed by Synopsys and its service providers.

On the AI side, the site highlights work on power and performance for AI and multi-die designs on the latest Samsung Foundry processes, presented at SAFE Forum 2026. No individual products are listed in the company's tracked product record, and no MCP servers are recorded for it.

The litigation record shows 281 matters in California, with no individual cases named. No lawsuits are listed separately for the company.
